correctness.rationale: The cosh-product reduction, Euler beta/residue formula, and fixed-frequency differential operator are algebraically exact. At zero delay the beta value is strictly positive; high-frequency leading sine and first derivative imply one simple root in every sufficiently high lobe and density |T|. After rescaling, smooth O(T²) convergence to y^(m) j_(m-1)(y), local uniform analyticity and simple Bessel roots imply the stated local simple branches. For the squared-secant case a tangent-line equation gives all roots exactly. Independent high-precision quadrature and Bessel-root comparisons support normalization, not infinitary proof.
